name: Wicket Actions - Base
brief: Base-App action providers for Wicket — post documents and journals
description: Companion to Wicket. Depends on the Base Application to own the strongly-typed posting calls (Sales-Post, Purch.-Post, journal batch posts, ...) that a System-Application-only extension cannot make, and exposes them through Wicket's invoke plane as enrolled, deny-by-default action wrappers.
